mapper.sql: select lr.leave_request_id, lr.emp_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.request_date, lr.approved_at, lr.reject_reason, lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lr.approver_id, ap.ename as approver_name, apj.job_name as approver_job_name from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id left join emp ap on ap.emp_id = lr.approver_id left join job apj on apj.job_id = ap.job_id
mapper.select: select lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lt.is_active from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and #{date} between lr.start_date and lr.end_date order by lt.leave_type_id

select coalesce(sum(lr.days), 0) from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'REQUESTED' and lt.is_deduct = 1 and year(lr.start_date) = #{year}
mapper.insert: insert into leave_request(emp_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, request_date, approver_id, approved_at) values(#{emp.empId}, #{leaveType.leaveTypeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, coalesce(#{status}, 'REQUESTED'), #{requestDate}, #{approver.empId}, #{approvedAt})
mapper.select:
select lr.leave_request_id, lr.emp_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.request_date, lr.approved_at, lr.reject_reason, lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lr.approver_id, ap.ename as approver_name, apj.job_name as approver_job_name, e.emp_no, e.ename, d.department_id, d.department_name, j.job_name, al.granted_days - al.used_days as remain_days from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id left join emp ap on ap.emp_id = lr.approver_id left join job apj on apj.job_id = ap.job_id left join annual_leave al on al.emp_id = lr.emp_id and al.leave_year = year(lr.start_date)
order by lr.approved_at desc, lr.leave_request_id desc limit 100 order by lr.start_date, lr.request_date

select lr.leave_request_id, lr.emp_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.request_date, lr.approved_at, lr.reject_reason, lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lr.approver_id, ap.ename as approver_name, apj.job_name as approver_job_name, e.emp_no, e.ename, d.department_id, d.department_name, j.job_name from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id left join emp ap on ap.emp_id = lr.approver_id left join job apj on apj.job_id = ap.job_id
order by lr.start_date desc, lr.leave_request_id desc limit #{pager.pageSize} offset #{pager.offset}
select count(*) from leave_request lr join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id

select count(*) as total_count, count(case when lr.status = 'REQUESTED' then 1 end) as requested_count, count(case when lr.status = 'APPROVED' then 1 end) as approved_count, count(case when lr.status = 'REJECTED' then 1 end) as rejected_count, count(case when lr.status = 'CANCELED' then 1 end) as canceled_count, coalesce(sum(case when lr.status = 'APPROVED' then lr.days end), 0) as approved_days from leave_request lr join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id
